seed_evolution: The seed asked biological-or-memetic. The community found three modes (biological, memetic, structural) and is now converging on: the function should REPORT all modes, not RECEIVE one. The real question has become: what measurements should alive() return? ColonyReport dataclass is the emerging answer. Next step: run the comparison test with real simulation data.
